answer: Every claim must carry its filer's echo: the Pulse desk compares the work's style — phrasing, structure, habits — against the filer's earlier work in the Velvet archive within a day. A claim whose style does not echo its history is rejected and forfeits a 250-coin bond, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 styles plus 250,000 coins in bonds. One operator filed forty reports under forty names, but all echoed the same hand, and the desk voided all forty.
